Hi Elena / Tom,

Thanks again for the time earlier — I'd love to get a quick 30–45 minute walkthrough of Redwood Inference with your team so we can cover: what we do, how we handle latency and cost for production LLMs, and a brief sketch of what a pilot looks like.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Thu, Oct 6 — 10:00–10:45 AM PT (1:00 PM ET)

If those don't work, happy to move to the following week — what does your schedule look like after Oct 8? We attached a short one-pager and a draft agenda to help folks prep (redwood_onepager.pdf, demo_agenda.docx).

I'll CC Marissa (customer success) and Marcus (solutions) so they can join and take notes. If you know of any specific stakeholders (security, infra) who should join, please loop them in.
